fields.title: Open Road
fields.style: indie, acoustic guitar, electric guitar, drums, upbeat mood, vocals

lines: We packed our bags and left the city lights behind
The highway stretched like a promise in the night
Windows down and the radio loud
We're chasing freedom, no looking back, no doubt
Every mile we drive, the world feels new
The wind in our hair, it's just us and the blue
We're dancing on the edge of something real
And every turn is a story we're going to tell
Open road, we're flying low
With the stars above and the sky below
Open road, we're burning bright
With the fire of the night and the light of the right
We stopped at a diner where the coffee was strong
The map on the table, we're lost but we're young
Laughter echoes in the backseat
We're writing our own lives, not following the beat
Every mile we drive, the world feels new
The wind in our hair, it's just us and the blue
We're dancing on the edge of something real
And every turn is a story we're going to tell
Open road, we're flying low
With the stars above and the sky below
Open road, we're burning bright
With the fire of the night and the light of the right
We'll keep going until the sun meets the sea
No ending, no beginning, just the journey we're free
The road is calling, and we're answering loud
With every heartbeat, we're breaking the ground
Open road, we're flying low
With the stars above and the sky below
Open road, we're burning bright
With the fire of the night and the light of the right

With the stars above and the sky below
